verdict.rationale: BugSnag supports rule-based automation such as automatic error assignment rules, alerting integrations (Slack/PagerDuty/webhooks) that trigger on error events, and actioning errors from Slack, which together constitute event-triggered automated actions. However there's no evidence of a general-purpose, user-defined rules engine spanning arbitrary conditions/actions or AI-native/agentic triggering. missing for 10: a documented flexible rules/automation engine beyond assignment and alert integrations, evidence of custom multi-condition rule building, and independent confirmation of reliability.
